svg.text: Rings only set timing. Each ring waits longer than the last, so a bad update is caught and paused before it reaches everyone.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Worst case for a device = deferral + deadline + grace. Broad catches every device not in another ring; Validated runs under its own approved change.

svg.text: SLA from release: actively exploited 7 days · Critical 14 · High 30 · Medium 60. Evidence for every checkpoint goes in the monthly change record.

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
